entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I see! The prices at a used[n]bookstore are all so low!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Hmm, there's a lot here...[n]Which ones would be good[n]as reference?
Autobiographies of great people.
Books on business.[clr 27]
Whatever's popular.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: The lives of people who have[n]left their names in history...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: True, those would be worth[n]reading once. There is a lot to[n]learn from their stormy lives!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Aha, a how-to book by someone[n]successful? I do get people[n]asking for work fortunes...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: But since I've never had, well,[n]a "normal" job, I didn't know[n]what to say sometimes.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Those would definitely[n]be worth reading!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Mmm, so new books that I could[n]read quickly and figure out[n]what's on everyone's minds.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: A lot of the time, a customer[n]might lower their guard with[n]some casual conversation...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Yes, it might be good to look[n]at the new books on offer.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Also, you know those self-help[n]books?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: With those, you feel like just[n]reading them is enough. You end[n]up not actually helping yourself.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I'd like to learn the ideas expressed[n]in those books, and use them to help[n]my customers.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: That used bookstore's sign [n]says "Study of Destiny"!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Wh... a fortune telling specific[n]shop!? [lName]-san,[n]let's go check it out!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I feel like this place could[n]feel like a second home...[n]Thank you so much for today.
